detail.longDescription: Personally, I don't like thinking about competition—it makes me anxious. I'd rather be like Matthew McConaughey at the 2014 Oscars and just compete with myself (or at least ramble about it until the exit music comes on). But in the business world, there's no way around thinking about your competitors. It's how brands know how to position themselves in the greater marketplace. The right competitor analysis software can make those efforts more informed, more accurate, and more efficient. So I talk
